scope: Six named adult criminal courts only; not blanket county coverage. Official source links, published fee information, manual self-filing resources. Not approved for paid packets or automated filing.

courts.name: Lucas County Court of Common Pleas
courts.formNote: Combined application; select sealing and the actual disposition. Attorney and applicant fields differ. Confirm current expungement/nonconviction variant with clerk.
courts.filing: Follow current Common Pleas instructions; no automated dispatch approved.

courts.name: Toledo Municipal Court
courts.formNote: Separate pro se motions. PDFs listed by clerk; direct retrieval failed during review. Counsel should confirm attorney filing format.
courts.filing: Clerk lists e-file, mail or in-person; dismissal also fax. No email. Confirm payment procedure.

courts.name: Franklin County Court of Common Pleas
courts.formNote: Use current conviction form under Criminal forms; nonconviction Form 96-F1 v7.22.2025 includes certificate of service. Current conviction PDF not independently retrieved; nonconviction text retrieved but visual review blocked.
courts.filing: Criminal e-filing exists; verify filing class, prosecutor service and fee method for represented applicant. No automated dispatch approved.

courts.name: Franklin County Municipal Court
courts.formNote: Combined 3-page application; check relief per case, applicant/attorney signature, deputy clerk service section not filled by applicant.
courts.filing: Mail or in person per instructions; money order payable to Franklin County Municipal Court; no checks of any kind. Confirm any separate e-filing method before integration.

courts.name: Hamilton County Court of Common Pleas
courts.formNote: Combined PDF: page 1 instructions; page 2 application. Select sealing versus expungement and actual result. Do not fill office-use fields.
courts.filing: Felony application: courthouse room 315, 1000 Main Street, Cincinnati. Confirm authorized submission and payment methods.

courts.name: Hamilton County Municipal Court
courts.formNote: Combined PDF: page 1 instructions; page 2 application and required investigation information. Choose one relief option. Preserve signature and office fields.
courts.filing: Misdemeanor application: Justice Center room 112, 1000 Sycamore Street, Cincinnati, per clerk. Confirm authorized submission and payment method.
